locator.title: 35+: ваше золотое время, чтобы сохранить молодость
locator.lead: Что происходит с яичниками после 35 и как продлить их (и свою) молодость

nearest_text_before.text: Он не умирает. Он просто «засыпает». Фолликулы есть, но они не растут. Гормоны не вырабатываются. И вы начинаете чувствовать все эти изменения.

nearest_text_after.text: Как проверить, что происходит с яичниками?

inputs.user_direction: Observed provider failure: the antique gold two-pan balance morphed into a round clock. Plan a canonical first-frame-only, non-loop five-second repair with fixed camera and long overlapping easing. Preserve the exact two-pan balance and locked central stand; allow only one shallow pan sway. Ovaries pulse once. The purple aura around the completely fixed progesterone molecule contracts and dims. Scale needle sweeps inside its dial; drops fall downward; irritation lines follow continuous irregular curves; battery fills red through yellow to full green and holds green. Preserve text, arrows, bonds, icons and layout. positive_prompt at most 480 characters. Include a concise observed-failure negative_prompt explicitly forbidding clock/dial substitution, object replacement, jerks, morphing and drift.

image_reading: A fixed educational infographic links ovaries to a progesterone molecule, a gold two-pan balance, and four symptom icons through arrows.

Movable details are limited to the ovaries, purple molecular aura, balance pans, scale needle, water drops, irritation scribbles, and battery fill; Russian text, chemical bonds, arrows, icons, and layout carry the meaning.
analysis.article_context: Body infographic after the explanation that reduced ovarian activity lowers hormone production and produces accumulating changes; it visualizes the causal link from ovaries and progesterone decline to weight, swelling, irritability, and fatigue.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation reinforces the article’s explanation that ovarian and progesterone changes are connected to a cluster of noticeable bodily symptoms.
structured_intent.primary_action: The linked hormonal and symptom indicators progress through one coordinated causal response.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The ovarian pulse has completed, the progesterone aura is smaller and dimmer, the balance is settled, symptom motions have completed, and the battery is fully green.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The image remains a readable causal medical infographic connecting ovaries and reduced progesterone with weight, swelling, irritability, and fatigue.

models.scene_plan: One fixed-camera five-second infographic animation with staggered, overlapping long eases. Begin the single ovarian pulse as the purple aura around the completely stationary progesterone molecule gradually contracts and dims. Overlap this with exactly one shallow sway of the balance pans while its antique two-pan form and central stand remain locked. Then ease the scale needle through its existing dial, move the drops downward, and extend the irritation marks along continuous irregular curves. The battery progresses from red through yellow to full green late in the shot and remains green in the final frame. No loop; all text, arrows, bonds, icons, and layout stay unchanged.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera, canonical first-frame-only non-loop motion. Over five seconds, use long overlapping eases: ovaries pulse once; the molecule stays fixed as its purple aura contracts and dims; the exact two-pan balance keeps its central stand locked while the pans make one shallow sway. The scale needle sweeps within its dial, drops fall, irritation lines trace continuous irregular curves, and the battery fills red through yellow to full green, holding green at the end.
models.negative_prompt: No clock or dial substitution for the antique two-pan balance; no object replacement, jerks, morphing, or layout drift. Do not alter text, arrows, chemical bonds, icons, or the locked central stand.
